rows.title: Resistance training twice a week
rows.why: Pattern insulin_resistance_early is the top system; resistance training is listed first in the management sequence and is the cheapest lever before any supplement.

rows.title: Walk 10 minutes after the largest meal every day
rows.why: Management of insulin_resistance_early lists a walk after the largest meal as the third lever; this is sequenced after confirming OGTT but can start immediately.

rows.title: Vitamin D3 4000 IU daily with largest meal
rows.why: Vitamin D 32.68 is below 40 and edge vitamin_d->insulin exists; raise before judging testosterone or lipids because user is 39-year-old male with no prior supplements.

rows.title: Protein and fibre at the start of every meal
rows.why: Management of insulin_resistance_early lists protein and fibre at the start of meals as second lever; sequenced after training starts because user has zero adherence.
